slices_machine.go.src:
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"slices"
)

func main() {
	f := []string{"pear", "fig", "apple"}
	fmt.Println("Contains(f, \"fig\") =", slices.Contains(f, "fig"))
	fmt.Println("Contains(f, \"kiwi\") =", slices.Contains(f, "kiwi"))
	fmt.Println("Index(f, \"apple\") =", slices.Index(f, "apple"))
	fmt.Println("Index(f, \"kiwi\") =", slices.Index(f, "kiwi"))
	fmt.Println("Max(f) =", slices.Max(f))
	g := slices.Clone(f)
	slices.Sort(g)
	fmt.Println("after Sort(g):", g)
	slices.Reverse(g)
	fmt.Println("after Reverse(g):", g)
}
